card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 98 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 16.4 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, RW Cam: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 97.5 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,968 parsecs away.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, RW Cam: Per, Rad, Dist
